entities.name: Julián Montoya

entities.summary: Julián Montoya is an Argentine professional rugby union player who plays as a hooker and captains the Argentina national team. He previously played for Premiership Rugby club Leicester Tigers, where he won the 2022 Premiership and was captain as Leicester were runners up in 2025.
